last_attempts_log.asr_text: For example, you can continue an official story in the service, or you can make your own story as a fan. What if that person showed up here? If it were me, I'd wanna see this happen. The ideas that grew with every turn of the page can now become a starting point for your own stories. The time spent waiting for what happens next may become time spent thinking up what happens next. What's more, you can publish the fan stories you make if you want to. You can enjoy them privately or let someone else read them. But things change when you make a story public. Will people understand this plot? I wanna work on what happens next a little more. You may find yourself thinking like a story maker before you know it, even though you started out as a reader.

last_attempts_log.asr_text: Of course, you can't bring in just anything you like; only works and characters approved by their original creators can be used. The help page also explains that the service has permission to use the original works it features through formal agreements with their creators. This is the foundation that lets you enjoy freely imagining what if. The service first offered two works and four characters in Japan. Taking part in a story here means moving the story forward through conversation or making a story as a fan. The fun of reading a work is joined by the fun of thinking up what happens next. Until now, if it were me, I'd do it this way was something you could only say to yourself. With Baias, those words become a way into making a story. What will you say to a character you love? What will happen next in the story? So, where will your next part begin?
